name: vrack2-journal-db
description: Append-only columnar journal DB for Node.js: gzip/zstd, dictionary/delta/RLE/numeric-codec columns, WAL with crash-safe flush, time-range queries that skip whole files via .meta sidecars, plus a metric engine: summaries, aggregate/timeline, vector scan, SQL-lite (SELECT + INSERT INTO), quantiles, and retention tiers with rollup and auto-maintenance (auto-compact, auto-rollup, auto-purge).
